speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth. To help me narrow down the cause, have you experienced any pain when you urinate, and do you have any unusual discharge or odor from your vagina?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum endometritis. The combination of fever, abdominal/uterine tenderness, increased urinary frequency, and decreased bowel sounds following a prolonged labor strongly suggests endometritis, potentially complicated by a fecal fistula or severe ileus. Please request a CBC with differential, blood cultures, and a urine culture immediately.
